pr_title: Fix samples not being preloaded before gameplay starts
pr_body:
Should reduce IO stutters during gameplay, especially on beatmaps with heavy custom hitsounding.

Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/17241. Can be tested with the two provided beatmaps (which both have hundreds of hitsounds) by adding a breakpoint in `Playfield.prepareSamplePool` after entering gameplay (ie. after `PlayerLoader` finishes the load sequence).

A few changes in this PR to make this work. Can be split out as dependencies but quite small and hopefully non-contentious:

## 6d6f73e016 Add overrides in `DrawableSliderTail` to explain/warn that this class never plays its own samples

Not strictly required to make this work, but is part of a flow I really could not understand while working through the tail sample playback logic. This makes things more explicit.

## 8676a2587c Add the ability for `HitObject`s to specify auxiliary samples

Used specifically for this optimisation, and nothing else (for now?).

## 4523393208 Removes `IsLayered` from `LegacyHitSampleInfo` comparison

The equality of samples is generally used to compare the sample equality, not its full properties. For instance, we don't compare `Volume` in the base implementation.

Having `IsLayered` here breaks actual usages of equality, ie. for pooling purposes.

## 39d95aa8cf Adds automatic preloading of sample pools at a `Playfield` level

This is the actual optimisation part of this PR.

issue_context.title: Hit sounds are not preloaded before a beatmap is played
issue_context.body:
For beatmaps with a large number of custom samples, this can cause a blocking IO overhead. A simple first step may be to move the sample load to an asychronous flow, but failing that we will need to restructure things a bit to make sure that samples are already in a loaded state before gameplay is started. ### Discussed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/discussions/17210
Originally posted by **NatureHog** March 11, 2022 I've got a really strange problem. On specific maps, which have multiple custom hitsounds the game stutters for a moment, right when the hitsounds are changing from one to another. This makes some beatmaps (almost) impossible to beat with "Beatmap Hitsounds" turned on... I came across two examples of this happening in my current database: [First Beatmap](https://osu.ppy.sh/beatmapsets/942641#osu/2056701) [Second Beatmap](https://osu.ppy.sh/beatmapsets/1309729#osu/2716381) Here are the logs of playing the first one above first with custom hitsounds then without, even though I personally didn't find anything helpful: [performance.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/8227646/performance.log) [runtime.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/8227647/runtime.log) [updater.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/8227648/updater.log) [database.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/8227649/database.log) [network.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/8227650/network.log) I am using Windows 11 with the newest .NET installed, if that is of any help.

review_comments: `IsLayered` should also not be accounted in `GetHashCode` right? otherwise the dictionary lookup will still fail if I recall how it works correctly.
Good call. It won't cause a failure, but may reduce the lookup efficiency I think.
